ModMetaData.name: Smokeleaf Plus
ModMetaData.author: sashasanley
ModMetaData.description:
Adds an advanced smokeleaf joint that requires research and advanced processing. Smokeleaf Plus provides the same mood boost as regular smokeleaf with almost no impairment, making it a superior choice for colonists who need to stay sharp.
Features: - New drug: Advanced Smokeleaf Joint - Same mood bonus as regular smokeleaf (+13) with ~83% less consciousness penalty and no movement penalty - Same pain relief as regular smokeleaf - Gentle wakeful edge (slightly reduced sleep fall rate) and mild munchies - Lower addiction and tolerance risk than regular joints - Requires research: Smokeleaf Refinement (Industrial tech) - Crafted at the Drug Lab: 8x smokeleaf leaves
Supports RimWorld 1.5 and 1.6.
